# Fonts for the launcher

Both under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (the OFL files beside them), from
github.com/google/fonts at 5026800714d07231937d92eb4cceabf06e05d74e:

- `RussoOne-Regular.ttf` (ofl/russoone): titles, menu items, prompts.
- `TitilliumWeb-Bold.ttf` (ofl/titilliumweb): the option lists.

They are compiled into the binary (`src/platform/launcher/embed.cmake`).
